annotations.annotation_text: The famous philosophical opening of Episode 3 (Proteus). Stephen walks along Sandymount Strand meditating on Aristotle's De Anima and Sense and Sensibilia: that visual perception is constrained by light and color ('the diaphane').
sources: Aristotle. De Anima, II.vii (trans. W. D. Ross). Oxford UP.
Gifford, Don, and Robert J. Seidman. Ulysses Annotated. UC Press, 1988, p. 44.

annotations.target_phrase: Signatures of all things I am here to read
annotations.annotation_text: Allusion to German mystic Jacob Boehme's De Signatura Rerum (The Signature of All Things, 1621). The external natural world (seaspawn, seawrack, rusty boots) presents divine glyphs requiring hermeneutic interpretation.
sources: Thornton, Weldon. Allusions in Ulysses. UNC Press, 1968.
